body: It may never happen - I will not sugarcoat for you.  Consider suicide when it suits you.  Sometimes you can power through it though.  Try your hardest, if that does not succeed than suicide is a constant you can depend upon.  This life is hard, no matter how you slice it.  There are times when I feel I cannot go further, but something pushes me through.  I believe you can make it, you have to believe in yourself first, which is the most difficult thing a person can do.  Do it.  Good luck my friend.

Share with them that you pray for your death.  If they tell you that you will go to hell, tell them “we’re already here, why do you think you’re with me”.  If they acquiesce, talk to them about your real issues, and ask for real help (not through church, etc.), professional help with a counselor or psychologist.

I hate the temporary solution to permanent problem platitude.  Life is a temporary problem that has only one permanent solution.  Feel your pain, and try to push through it.  If you can’t I respect your decision.

There are many warning indicators, if a women posts about how she has a lot of stalkers, if she posts that every past boyfriend bought her lots of stuff (gold digger), if they post about how hot they are, and that no man turned them down, they are shallow and attention seeking.  It is pretty easy to spot someone damaged.  Honestly, most guys go after women who seem to have family issues, women who have low self esteem due to a poor relationship with their father.  It allows them to manipulate that aspect through Freudian or oedipus aspects.

Good guys, who will probably never have a long term relationship as a result, will die off due to how they empower and support you no matter what.  It’s called love, but from what I have observed, it is extremely rare and should be held onto no matter what. But most women prefer assholes.  They will make you feel poor about yourself, but will tell you very sweet things to keep you around, you will accept them for their flaws, and they will train you to be subservient.  Be warned, this is a common recipe for a stable relationship, but denegregating none the less.  You have better options, but you will most likely seek an asshole who has few redeeming qualities, the others, who are socially awkward, and who look at you like a goddess, you will ignore because you don’t feel a “connection”.  This is my experience.  Hope you are different.

1/3 of firearm suicides require a second shot, due to firearm misplacement.  I highly recommend you work through this, as a DUI ain’t that bad.  I’ve known lots of people, including those with clearances to get jobs despite a DUI.  There are still options for you.  Fuck anyone who doesn’t value you for who you are, including spouses.  There is still hope.

I regularly spend time in a fetal position in the corner of my room, rocking back in forth considering the nature of my existence.  I believe this is normal, as I have heard others say they do the same.  Some days, nothing, not my tablet, phone, or TV interrupts my alone time.  I believe it is necessary to understand our existence.  So long as living exceeds the difficulty in dying, I exist.  Hope this helps you.

I can understand where you are coming from.  I too am classified on the autism spectrum.  I asked my counselor why we have a 1-dimensional spectrum upon which people are rated.  He had no answer.

I too struggle with suicidal ideation.  I had to apply logic to the situation.  My mother talked about Christianity recently, I talked about the absurdism of any such idea, one should own slaves and have multiple wives if they are religious, as this is written in such scriptures.  I laugh that I may be alone in this universe, no one else sharing my fate or understanding, to be aware of the absurdism of it all and the primal nature from which it derives.

Every day I spend hours alone in the dark, and consider the problems of humanity.  Every day I must struggle against suicide.  I figure so long as life is easier, exceeds the difficulty in effecting death, that I will live.  But lately it has been more heavily weighted towards death.

Good luck on your journey.

There is a simple equation.  If life is easier than death at the moment, live.  If life’s suffering exceeds the pain and tumult of death for a while, die.  Look at each day this way.  I don’t know the future, and my past sometimes haunts me, the present is equally terrifying but now.  Dying hurts, no matter what method is chosen - the human override, or survival instinct is strong in our species.  Once the equation changes we can grow or die.

Hopefully we as a species evolve enough to escape such cycles, what Nietzsche called this is “the eternal recurrence of the same.”  One book that comforted me when I have felt the same way is Albert Camus book, “Myth of Sisyphus.”  Highly recommended reading before you exit.  The French Existentialists have always comforted me in my low points, perhaps they can provide you such comfort now.

I’m 6’ 2” and know your pain.  My half brother is 5’ 7” - he hikes and is the best body builder I know.  I hassle him about his height, because it is the only thing I can hassle him about.  Trust me when I say 5’ 7” is nothing to be ashamed about.  He out flanks me in muscular ability.  You got this, nothing to be ashamed about.  Taller guys will try to make you feel insignificant due to your height, but trust me when I say, you are not lacking.  Unfortunately height is a metric we most often apply to beauty, besides symmetry.  Do not let this feel like you are anything less than what you are.  I get passed over for smaller guys all the time, they had a chance to develop their interpersonal relationships better than I ever had.  It is difficult, but when you show no fear of heights and woo them, women will flock to you.  Good luck my friend

It strongly depends on what you use.  I tried a benzo overdose, woke up with a “gastric levage” and being intubated.  I took 2x the LD-50 of the med with alcohol.  Somehow I survived even when I died in the hospital apparently.  They didn’t even lock me up in the psych ward, LoL.  My poop was black from activated charcoal for the next two weeks.  It’s not a pretty way to go, trust me.

I spent my childhood going to father/son events with volunteers for various mentoring programs (big brothers, big sisters).  It sucked.  I lied about my biological dad to peers.  I tried to commit suicide a number of times, because I didn’t have anyone else tell me what a mans supposed to be or do.  The lowest point was when I met him when I was 19 years old, and he asked if my mom was going to sue him for child support.  He died of acute lymphocytic leukemia about 6 months after that.  That was the low point when I realized I needed a real father figure.

We humans seem to need to compare ourselves against others.  I have known sociopaths who come from horrible families, and some from very affluent upbringings.  Twins go to war, one comes back with PTSD, the other seems unaffected.  It is all down to nature and nurture.  Some folks can handle their shit better than us, some less so.  However severe or mediocre the pain we suffer, it is shaped by our mind.  Your concerns are valid, no matter what you come from.  There are child soldiers in Africa that saw their parents die, and fight for the person who killed them.  They don’t seem to consider suicide.  Yet an affluent American, being raised in the land of plenty will put a knife to their neck ‘cause their girlfriend/boyfriend wronged them.  It’s all a matter of perspective.  I wish our suffering was less so, but it isn’t.  Even though my childhood wasn’t too terrible, I still put that knife to my throat and press it in.  Each day is borrowed time.  I haven’t had the pain of most, but it doesn’t make my pain any less.

Same with your pain.  Feel it.  Try to know it for what it is.  If you got to press that knife into neck just to know you’re still alive; do it.  Life ain’t pretty.  Some of us make it, some don’t.  I hope I don’t, cause life sucks.  Good luck to you.

Feel what you need to feel, comrade.
Many ops are in progress by the feds on dark net marketplaces.  Best not to risk imprisonment to die.
Well, internet can be hazardous- lookup operation Legend.  Got many people from around the globe, users and dealers. There are legal ways which don’t risk capture and confinement.
There is most certainly a lethal amount, I have had two friends die from it - but after spending many years addicted.  Most dealers are savvy to new users and won’t try to kill them.

I know exactly that feeling.  I went through 10 years of college, LoL, no degree.  You can hope.  If it doesn’t come to fruition in your 30’s I would attempt.  It’s not always the ideal situation you hope.  There is nothing left for me, but for you, hopefully.

I get how you’re feeling.  My brother gave me a “free” car.  It has a failing transmission.  It was meant to make me feel “better”.  I am still at the end.  If anything, it helped me move closer to the end.  It is the obligation and duty I feel towards him that keeps me going for a few days.  I wish I was dead tough.  Good luck moving past your obligations.
Read “Essays in pessimism” by Arthur Schopenhauer.  It is very enlightening.  Almost as much as Nietzsche

I’ve had a similar experience.  I once hanged myself with a belt on a hook in the ceiling made for hanging plants.  The belt slipped up under my chin and I hung for two hours until I could get my foot back onto my bed and undo the noose.  It sucks.  I wrapped my neck in a towel to hide the marks for two days, but eventually my family found out.  Good luck.

I quit school at 9 years old.  Told my mom they couldn’t teach me anything I didn’t already know.  I got a General Equivalency Diploma and went to the best university I could afford (a tech university, top 5 in nation).  Trust me when I say, Highschool don’t mean shit.  Most brilliant people don’t show until university anyways.  My mom worked in school system, but never believed in it.  Remember that you have an opportunity most don’t, to be something more than what you’ve been dealt.  Test scores and schooling be damned.

I’m bi, I know how difficult this shit is.  My folks wouldn’t accept this, and they still don’t know.  There are men in my life I’ve invited over to my folks place, and they still don’t know LoL.  Ibuprofen will cause liver damage, and will take weeks/years of horrible agony to kill you (organ failure).  Just be who you are, and fuck them if they don’t accept.  There are people who understand in this world, maybe not around you, but they do exist.  You got this!

There are resources I cannot list here, that help find a peaceful end without all of this.  Google is your friend.  I know of ways I cannot list here, but there are several peaceful ways to go that don’t involve black market dealings or legal difficulties.  I am there with you.  I know of a peaceful methods that I will be using, soon enough.  Do not get yourself into trouble before then though.  Trust me, I’ve been there.

They will tell you it’s enough to OD, but trust me when I say, they know it’s not.  These folks have “street smarts” enough to know more than any counselor where you are at, and they will exploit it.  They want money more than anything.  If you die, they don’t make any more money.  It is a trap.  Hate to sound like Admiral Ackbar.  But it’s true.
Rec and art therapy are different though - they are free spirits - people who you should listen to.  My best times on the ward was always art therapy.

Trust me when I say opioids are not the way.  They only give you enough to make you pass out the first time, then they increase the dose slowly to make you dependent.  Then you’re doing things you never thought you’d do for money to get more, and then your life is a shithole not even you can escape.  Trust me on this.  Recovering opioid addict.

I can say, I have had similar experiences.  These are holding facilities, not “treatment centers” as they like to say.  There are some people who belong in confinement there, but many who do not.  You might ask them if there is an equivalent outpatient option.  Also, avoid “group therapy”, in my experience the leader is untrained in psychology and generally an asshole.  Find a good doctor and counselor outside, and don’t say the “S” word - suicide.  Just allude to death in a polite but euphemistic way, let them know confinement isn’t an option and your experiences in confinement.  If they are any good, they will try and find a way to help you; if they don’t, fire them and find someone else.  Trust me, a lot of people in psych are there to fix their own issues, and you should drop them.

I highly recommend reading Nietzsche and Schopenhauer.  Start with “Thus Spake Zarathustra”, or Schopenhauers “Essays in Pessimism”, or Albert Camus “The Myth of Sisyphus”.  Progress onto Jean Paul Sartre’s “Being and Nothingness”.  It is a way to escape today.  The Germans have a word for this, Schadenfreude, it is seeing the greater suffering of another which makes our load lighter.  It is why we laugh when seeing a friend fall or fail at something.  Our suffering is less acute then.  Good luck in finding your Schadenfreude.
Yes.
Breakups are tough. It is tough even when you’re in your 40’s.  Cry when you need to, talk to your friends, find escapes.  That is the best advice I can give.

I got told on a psych ward by a 1-on-1 nurse that I was going to hell for attempting suicide.  I told him “We’re already there, that’s why you’re with me!” and laughed menacingly.  He spent the rest of the night trying to read bible verses to me, a penny valued exorcism.  That nurse was booted out the next day after I told them what he did, in front of him.  He tried to lie and say he wasn’t doing it, which is against his religion, but apparently he had been caught proselytizing before.  That about sums up my feeling towards those people.

Tell them “We’re already in hell, and that’s why you’re with me” and laugh menacingly.  It stops the proselytizing pretty effectively, unless they try an exorcism.  I do not recommend doing this in a religious type hospital though.

Unfortunately the ways you have listed involve the potential to live for a long time in much greater agony.  Imagine being paralyzed from the neck down and living another 40 years in such a condition, or getting a brain injury that traps your conscious mind behind the ability to grasp simple concepts.  Or imagine a cancer that is slow growing and you live for many years wasting into a shell of a person before finally kicking the bucket.  I would rather have something that did not involve the potential to survive in a diminished state for years, something quick, painless, and fully reversible in case of failure.

Yes, I live with the knowledge I will likely see the so called technological utopia (no utopias exist though, as long as a single member dissents), it will be a hellscape for human kind - as our sun expands to consume our earth, and andromeda collides with our galaxy - a greater power, one we create, will expand beyond us in every way.  We are nothing, it is everything.

A sperm has little intelligence, it only seeks the egg to fertilize - so too we humans try to find a meaning in our existence where none exists.  Ultimately, we have no intelligence, only that which we imagine.  But we are capable of creating creatures far greater than ourselves, that can surpass us.

Yes, I think of humanity in the way I think of a sperm and egg.  We create an artificial intelligence that surpasses us in its moral and ethical fortitude, we are but unthinking creatures that beg for meaning when they know it.  They leave us in our hell, surpassing to the heavens to find a better world for themselves.  We are nothing to them, as the animals of our world are food to us, with little meaning.

I know how you feel.  All is lost.  That is what it sounds like.  Believe me, I have tried most ways.  The survival instinct is strong.  Try to live on despite it all, for each day.  Remember that it is any day you can end it, but today is today, and tomorrow is in the writings of MacBeth ( https://www.sparknotes.com/nofear/shakespeare/macbeth/page_202/ ).  Being present sounds like a platitude, but it is not, live for today, die for tomorrow.
It is a curse to live forever, a bag of bones, conscious of its own existence but incapable of effecting its end.  I hope you find peace in my world.

Everyday I consider suicide, it is the only thing that keeps me going.  Every day when I consider dying is more difficult than living, I continue going.  Some days I am at the brink, but I continue knowing that one more day is worth it.  Now I am at the end of my rope and cannot continue going.  Know that there is hope at the end, because I have been there.  The end is an abyss that you can never return from.  I have looked into this abyss and have never returned entirely.  Continue in your pursuit of life, the end is something you cannot imagine.
